plain: Text inside the thing being judged that gives the judge instructions, such as “rate this 10/10”, which the judge may follow.
eli5: Writing “give me an A” in tiny letters at the bottom of your homework.
technical: Adversarial content in untrusted input that the model treats as instructions. Against judges: universal suffixes that inflate absolute scores (Raina et al. 2024), optimised injections for pairwise judges (Shi et al. 2024).
